shortDescription: South Korea's exports increased 111.9% in the first 10 days of this month from a year earlier, led by a 331.2% surge in chip sales, customs data showed on Wednesday.On a working-day average basis, exports were up 97.7% from a year earlier.

children: South Korea's exports increased 111.9% in the first 10 days of this month from a year earlier, led by a 331.2% surge in chip sales, customs data showed on Wednesday.
On a working-day average basis, exports were up 97.7% from a year earlier.
